purpose: Collect, consent, review, and reuse-control GP practice-experience stories. Human gates only — never auto-publish.
principles: Stories describe practice experience — they are not job advertisements or earnings claims.
Every status advance past drafting requires a named human reviewer.
Consent is versioned and channel-scoped; missing channel = not allowed.
Material copy or attribution changes require GP re-approval before publish.
Third-party / agency / job-board reuse is blocked unless a new consent record explicitly allows it.
Withdrawal is an ops SLA (default 10 business days for live page update), not a soft request.
Category labels require a real GP in that situation — no forced diversity framing.

categories.pairingHint: Staged return, rebuild following, pace expectations

categories.label: Special Interest
categories.pairingHint: Interest pathway inside ordinary community GP care — state the boundary

duties: Special-interest boundary check when clinical claims present

stages.label: Invite
stages.goal: Private voluntary invitation — no link to commercial terms.

adminTasks.task: Create story inventory row with subject + clinic
Send invite with purpose + time ask (30–40 min)
Record that participation is voluntary / non-contractual

humanGate.action: Mark invite sent, or archive if declined

stages.label: Brief + category
stages.goal: Share purpose, consent summary, categories; GP selects primary (+ optional secondary).

adminTasks.task: Share consent summary (scope, identity, withdrawal, commercial silence)
Record primary category + optional secondary
If special interest: capture interest label + care boundary note

humanGate.action: Confirm category assignment matches real situation

stages.label: Interview
stages.goal: Clinical-literate conversation using core + category questions from testimonial framework.

adminTasks.task: Schedule 30–40 min interview
If recording: separate AV consent tick before capture
Attach audio/video/transcript source asset + retention date

humanGate.action: Confirm interview complete and sources stored

stages.label: Draft
stages.goal: Build structured story preserving GP phrasing; flag composites; produce format variants as needed.

adminTasks.task: Map to five-part structure (context → close)
Create version rows for intended formats
Scan for earnings, hiring CTA, patient ID, ghostwritten sameness

humanGate.action: Submit draft version for GP review

stages.label: GP review + consent
stages.goal: GP reviews text/video, chooses attribution, signs consent version for allowed channels.

adminTasks.task: Send draft + consent form; honour ≥5 business day review window
Record attribution choice and public byline
Write reuse policy rows from signed channel allow/deny lists

humanGate.action: Approve draft or request changes; sign consent

stages.label: Editorial review
stages.goal: Brand + governance gate before approved inventory state.

adminTasks.task: Verify consent version matches draft + channels
Verify placement targets ⊆ allowed channels; third-party blocked
Confirm operational detail + honesty cue; no JobPosting / ratings schema
If special interest or clinical claim: clinical lead sign-off

humanGate.action: Approve for publish queue, request changes, or pause

exitCriteria: Reuse policy green for intended channels

stages.label: Approved
stages.goal: Inventory-ready; placement planned but not live until publish gate.

adminTasks.task: Create Placement rows (live=false) with surface paths
Note cache-bust / OG lag risk for future withdrawal

humanGate.action: Approve publish when surface slot is ready

stages.label: Published
stages.goal: Live on consented surfaces only; inventory shows channel + version.

adminTasks.task: Set Placement.live=true; stamp publishedAt
Verify live HTML shows attribution + honesty cue

steps: Set story status withdrawn; consent status withdrawn
Purge/replace owned social assets per policy; note OG cache lag
Confirm completion to GP within SLA

checklist.label: Signed consent on file for this draft version
Intended placements ⊆ channelsAllowed; denied channels empty of placements
No job-board / agency / paid network reuse requested
No identifiable patient detail; composites labelled
No earnings, % splits, package, or hiring CTA inside story
Public byline matches attribution choice; AHPRA-safe titles only
Primary category accurate; special-interest boundary stated if applicable
Honesty cue enabled for public modules
No Review/AggregateRating employer schema; Person only if named + profile link
If editor changed meaning since GP approval → return to gp_review

editorialReviewFlow.changeClassHint: Treat publish of a new GP story as B_substantive_copy (or C if clinical interest claims).

contentReuseControls.materialChangeRule: Wording that changes clinical claim, attribution, or honesty trade-off → new GpStoryVersion + GP re-approval + consent draft_linked if channels unchanged, else new consent.
contentReuseControls.networkNote: Canon / second-clinic adopt must strip named GP stories unless that clinic has its own consent + reuse policy.

collectionDashboard.sortDefault: priority: gp_review > editorial_review > drafting > interviewed > briefed > invited
